label: Songduo yak

about.text: The Songduo is a Chinese yak population that is milked. A 2023 review of yak milk lists its milk solids at about 18.4 percent and its fat at about 7.1 percent.

links.name: Yak Milk: Nutritional Value, Functional Activity, and Current Applications (Foods, 2023)

sources.text: Table 1 of the review, which gives per-breed composition for Chinese milked yak populations. The review does not describe the Songduo's range or husbandry in the parts read.

sources.text: The review is by Chinese authors and covers Chinese yak populations, including the Songduo.
